alerts.headline: Freeze Warning issued November 25 at 11:15AM CST until November 26 at 9:00AM CST by NWS Austin/San Antonio TX
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Sub-freezing temperatures between 26 and 32 expected.

* WHERE...Atascosa, Bandera, Bastrop, Bexar, Caldwell, Comal,
Guadalupe, Hays, Medina, Travis, Williamson, and Wilson Counties.

* WHEN...From 3 AM to 9 AM CST Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Frost and freeze conditions could kill crops, other
sensitive vegetation and possibly damage unprotected outdoor
plumbing.
alerts.instruction:
Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold.

To prevent water pipes from freezing; wrap or drain or allow them to
drip slowly.
